info.description: The Education Enrollment Management API facilitates the process of enrolling students into educational programs. By allowing institutions to efficiently manage student enrollments, it supports a streamlined approach to admissions. This API is particularly valuable for educational administrators and software systems that handle student information, providing functionalities to initiate and record new enrollments. Use cases include integrating with student information systems, managing class capacities, and supporting data capture for reporting purposes.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new enrollment in the system by providing the necessary details. Upon successful creation, the system will return the enrollment details.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to create a new enrollment. Please ensure that all required fields are properly filled out to successfully process the enrollment.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the enrollment details are returned.
